name: Soul Sheath
body:
Drawing on the magic inherent to the ritual that gave you a body, you can create a sheath of spiritual energy around your fits that resembles your weapon form.

Prerequisite(s): Arma, base attack bonus +1

Benefit(s): The arma may, as a move action, grant his unarmed strikes the weapon profile of his weapon form. Changing back is a move action as well; in the case of a ranged weapon the arma may fire his ranged weapon as though he were wielding it. If your weapon form is a ranged weapon you must still provide ammunition.
